hooks.name: Load Project Context on Session Start
hooks.description: On session start, reminds the agent to load project context from engram and steering files before doing any work.

action.prompt: This is the LzDetailingStore Backend project (.NET 10, C#, PostgreSQL). Before doing any work: 1) Read .kiro/steering/ files for architecture decisions, conventions, API design, and database model. 2) Search engram for 'lzdetailingstorebackend' to recover prior session context and decisions. 3) Check if SDD artifacts exist via mem_search for the current change. The project uses Clean Architecture + Vertical Slices + CQRS with MediatR. All responses must be in Mexican Spanish.
